_about: Public-domain Gregory Thurston Bedell (1817-1892), evangelical Episcopal Bishop of Ohio after McIlvaine, son of Gregory Townsend Bedell, for the Word Hoard: The Trusteeship of the Gospel (1869), The Canterbury Pilgrimage (1878) and The Pastor: Pastoral Theology (1880), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 55 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gthbedell-canterbury-pilgrimage: The Canterbury pilgrimage : to and from the Lambeth Conference and the Sheffield Congress (New York : A.D.F. Randolph, 1878)
gthbedell-pastor: The pastor. Pastoral theology (Philadelphia, London, J.B. Lippincott & co., 1880)
